prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about opening a new knowledge world for the first time. Around 76 BPM, F Lydian. A small music-box figure becomes felt piano, then a single clarinet and chamber strings. Curious and inviting rather than ceremonial. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No fanfare, no choir swell, no sudden transients.

[00:00–00:18] Music-box motif, close and dry, as if a lid just lifted.
[00:18–00:55] Felt piano doubles the motif; soft mallets add a second interval.
[00:55–01:40] Clarinet enters with a long Lydian line; strings hold a transparent bed.
[01:40–02:30] The motif returns simpler, as if the door is now open and the room is quiet.
